cosInstance.description:
cosInstance contains options to configure a supporting IBM Cloud COS instance and bucket
for this cluster. It is currently used for nodes requiring Ignition for bootstrapping.

bucketName.description: bucketName is the name of the IBM Cloud COS bucket used for Ignition bootstrapping.

bucketRegion.description: bucketRegion is the IBM Cloud region where the COS bucket resides or will be created.

provision.description: provision contains the configuration for provisioning a new COS instance and bucket.

name.description:
name defines the explicit name of the IBM Cloud COS instance to be created.
If omitted, the system will dynamically create it using the cluster name.

reference.description: reference contains the information to identify an existing COS instance.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: exactly one of id or name must be specified

type.description: type defines whether to use an existing COS instance or provision a new one.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: COS instance type is immutable once set
reference configuration is required when type is Reference, and forbidden otherwise
provision configuration is forbidden when type is not Provision; it is optional when type is Provision

ignition.description: ignition defines options related to the bootstrapping systems where Ignition is used.

version.description: version defines which version of Ignition will be used to generate bootstrap data.

loadBalancers.description:
loadBalancers contains information about IBM Cloud VPC Load Balancer resources.
This field is rejected by the API if the Topology is set to VirtualIP.

items.description: LoadBalancerSource defines how the IBM Cloud VPC Load Balancer is sourced.

provision.description: provision contains the configuration for provisioning a new Load Balancer.

additionalListeners.description: additionalListeners sets the additional listeners for the load balancer.

items.description:
AdditionalListener defines the desired state of an
additional listener on a VPC load balancer.

defaultPoolName.description: defaultPoolName defines the name of a VPC Load Balancer Backend Pool to use for the VPC Load Balancer Listener.

port.description: port sets the port for the additional listener.

protocol.description:
protocol defines the protocol to use for the VPC Load Balancer Listener.
Will default to TCP protocol if not specified.

selector.description:
selector is used to find IBMPowerVSMachines with matching labels.
If the label matches, the machine is then added to the load balancer listener configuration.

matchExpressions.description: matchExpressions is a list of label selector requirements. The requirements are ANDed.

items.description:
A label selector requirement is a selector that contains values, a key, and an operator that
relates the key and values.

key.description: key is the label key that the selector applies to.

operator.description:
operator represents a key's relationship to a set of values.
Valid operators are In, NotIn, Exists and DoesNotExist.

values.description:
values is an array of string values. If the operator is In or NotIn,
the values array must be non-empty. If the operator is Exists or DoesNotExist,
the values array must be empty. This array is replaced during a strategic
merge patch.

matchLabels.description:
matchLabels is a map of {key,value} pairs. A single {key,value} in the matchLabels
map is equivalent to an element of matchExpressions, whose key field is "key", the
operator is "In", and the values array contains only "value". The requirements are ANDed.

items.description: LoadBalancerBackendPool defines the desired configuration of a VPC Load Balancer Backend Pool.

algorithm.description: algorithm defines the load balancing algorithm to use.

healthMonitor.description: healthMonitor defines the backend pool's health monitor.

delay.description: delay defines the seconds to wait between health checks.

port.description: port defines the port to perform health monitoring on.

retries.description: retries defines the max retries for health check.

timeout.description: timeout defines the seconds to wait for a health check response.

type.description: type defines the protocol used for health checks.

urlPath.description: urlPath defines the URL to use for health monitoring.

network.description: network specifies how the PowerVS network should be sourced.

provision.description: provision provides the configuration for the controller to CREATE a new Network and DHCP Server.

dhcpServer.description: dhcpServer contains the configuration for the DHCP server that will be created.

cidr.description: cidr is the CIDR for the DHCP private network.

dnsServer.description: dnsServer is the DNS Server for the DHCP service.

name.description:
name is the name of the DHCP Service to be created. Only alphanumeric characters and dashes are allowed.
If omitted, the name will default to DHCPSERVER<CLUSTER_NAME>_Private.

snat.description:
snat indicates the SNAT policy for the DHCP service.
Allowed values are "Enabled" and "Disabled".
If omitted, the system will choose a Enabled policy by default.

workspace.description:
workspace specifies how the PowerVS workspace is sourced.
A PowerVS workspace is a container for PowerVS resources in a specific zone.
More details: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/power-iaas?topic=power-iaas-creating-power-virtual-server

name is the explicit name of the workspace to be created.
If omitted, the system will dynamically create the workspace with the name <CLUSTER_NAME>-workspace.

reference.description:
reference tells the controller to use an existing PowerVS workspace.
Supported identifiers are name and id.
If more than one workspace has the same name, use id.
